articles.title: Disney Channel star who worked with Kevin Costner and Meg Ryan then acted on Seinfeld surfaces at 68... can YOU guess who he is?
articles.summary: A beloved Disney Channel star from the 2000s, aged 68, was recently spotted in Los Angeles. Despite his age, he appeared sprightly and energetic while running errands, continuing a long acting career that began in the 1980s. This sighting offers fans a glimpse into the continued vitality of a prominent entertainment figure decades after his rise to fame.

articles.title: Modi, Xi shake hands, talk on sidelines of SCO Summit ahead of BRICS meet
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping recently exchanged a handshake and brief conversation, signaling a potential thaw in India-China relations despite past border tensions. This high-level diplomatic interaction is crucial for SSB aspirants to understand, as it highlights efforts to manage bilateral ties, influencing India's strategic position, regional stability, and national security through diplomatic engagement.

articles.title: Lanterns: The Name Of Laura Linney's Character Sparks Intriguing Twist Theory - Spoilers
articles.summary: The 'Lanterns' series recently continued with a new John Stewart-centric episode titled 'OutKast.' This installment notably featured the debut of acclaimed actress Laura Linney taking on the role of one of the powerful Guardians of the Universe. Further narrative details are expected to be revealed through the episode's subtitles, adding layers to the ongoing storyline.

articles.title: Air Vice Marshal Shakti Sharma scripts history with AVM-rank appointment
articles.summary: Air Vice Marshal Shakti Sharma has achieved a historic milestone, becoming the first woman officer from a non-medical background in the Indian armed forces to attain the rank of Air Vice Marshal. This landmark promotion within the Indian Air Force signifies a significant advancement, breaking barriers and paving the way for greater inclusion and leadership opportunities for women across the nation's defence services.

articles.title: We must resolve to transform all defence PSUs into global giants: Rajnath Singh
articles.summary: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh underscored that the progress of defence Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) is a "national security imperative," not just an economic need. He urged them to prioritize innovation, self-reliance, and timely delivery to bolster India's defence capabilities. This emphasizes the critical role of indigenous defence production in securing the nation and reducing import dependence, crucial for national strategic autonomy.

articles.title: Military Microreactors on Bases Could Kick-Start US Nuclear Power, Increase Readiness
articles.summary: The Pentagon is exploring small nuclear reactors as a solution to prevent power outages at military installations, which can severely impact operational readiness. These compact reactors offer a reliable, independent power source, enhancing national security and ensuring critical defence infrastructure remains functional even during extended grid failures. This initiative aims to bolster energy resilience for military bases.

articles.title: After S-400, India plans S-500 missile system and Su-57 fifth-generation fighter from Russia
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi and Russian President Putin are engaged in key defence discussions, focusing on advanced military hardware. Potential acquisition of the S-500 missile defence system and the Su-57 stealth fighter are central topics. These talks underscore India's ongoing strategic partnership with Russia and its efforts to modernize its armed forces, crucial for regional security and power projection.

articles.title: Bond sell-off accelerates globally amid inflation fears
articles.summary: A significant global bond sell-off deepened, driving UK borrowing costs to their highest level since 2008 and Japan's to peaks unseen since the 1990s. This market reaction stems from investor expectations that central banks worldwide will intensify interest rate hikes to combat persistent inflation. Such international financial shifts can significantly impact global economies and national fiscal policies.
